race.comment: NICISH (2) has relished stretching out in trip and is in career-best form. She's been showing good tactical speed, so from the low draw she should be able to hold a spot, and the form around her is stacking right up. Hard not to see her involved at the pointy end. TALISAY (12) made a strong return here two weeks ago, charging late to just miss. She's been brought on further with a jumpout in between runs but is drawn to get a long way back again. Watch for her powering late. MAXILDO (4) is in red-hot touch, making it two pillar-to-post wins in a row here last time, and the form around him is also strong. If it ain't broke, don't fix it. He'll give another strong sight. BIG SUE (6) got the bob here three back and has been okay in his next two. Drawn much kinder this time and deserves inclusion. BROWN NOSE DAY GAL (7) is an intriguing 9YO. She was well below her best fresh but can improve sharply out to this trip. Don't dismiss.
